paragraphs: What's up, my crew? It's your boy, the pastor, and for real, I've got major love for you guys. And it's not just me—everyone who's in on the big secret, the Truth that's basically living inside us, they're all on the same page.
Wishing you all the good stuff—grace, mercy, and peace. It's all coming straight from the big boss, God the Father, and his Son, Jesus Christ. That's how much He loves you.

Man, I was so stoked to hear that a bunch of you are actually living out the Truth, just like the Father told us to. Quick reminder, though, and this isn't some new rule, it's the OG one: we gotta have each other's backs. Love is the main quest. And love just means following the rules. The biggest rule? Live a life of love. You've known this from the jump, nothing's new here.

Now for the serious talk. There are a ton of scammers out there, real smooth-talkers, who are trying to sell you the lie that Jesus wasn't a real guy, like, a legit human being. Let's call them what they are: Fakers and Anti-Christs. Total posers.

So, you gotta be super careful around them. Don't let them scam you out of the awesome stuff we've all been working for. I want you to get the full reward, every bit of it. Anyone who gets too "woke" and ditches what Christ taught is basically ghosting God. But if you stick with the program, you're tight with both the Father and the Son. It's an amazing change.

If one of these fakers shows up, don't even let them in your house. Don't give them a place to crash. If you do, you're basically helping them spread their lies, and you become a partner in their evil work.

I've got way more to say, but I'm not gonna write it all. I'm hoping to roll through soon and we can have a real heart-to-heart. That'll be way better for both of us. Everyone from your sister church says hi.
